source.tonalRampPurpose: Derived preview strips from the current frontmatter colors only; not additional shipping palette tokens.
source.verificationScope: Merged documentation of implemented local simulation controls and visual changes; no physical equipment or production/Gate0 approval.

continuousSimulation.source: Optional same-origin /api/live, schema_version 1; 404 means legacy static mode.
continuousSimulation.polling: Next round 2000ms after completion; three background preview workers; hidden-page pause; abort and timer cleanup.
continuousSimulation.freshness: 6000ms request timeout; 10000ms status heartbeat expiry, including fully paused sessions. Intentional capture pause does not expire a valid service heartbeat; errors and stale states remain explicit.
continuousSimulation.readingPosition: History, full range, manual inspection and reports remain stable until explicit return to latest.
continuousSimulation.queueUnit: Pending analysis batches, not raw samples or a claim of NPZ serialization.
continuousSimulation.report: Continuous simulation summary; passed null, detection rate unassessed without controlled truth.
continuousSimulation.layout: Desktop roster is viewport-limited; narrow roster remains horizontal. Simulation rate/observation panels stack below 900px; flow stations form two rows below 650px.
continuousSimulation.visuals: Existing ivory grid and metal components; local G15 type layers. SVG rates use real counter deltas and a bounded history, never random telemetry.
continuousSimulation.controls: Same-origin /api/live/control with session_id, pause/resume and optional run_id/device_id; pause new capture, drain queued work, resume same run and sequence. No physical equipment control.

industrialRail.behavior: Hover or keyboard focus expands. Logo click pins; next click collapses and restores auto mode. Touch uses the logo toggle. Pin preference persists in localStorage. Navigation keeps accessible names.
industrialRail.logo: User-supplied g15-logo.png, cropped to its left mark only while collapsed; full horizontal mark when expanded.
industrialRail.narrowLayout: Vertical nowrap rail with stretch alignment; scrollable nav remains before the footer at every breakpoint. Visible mobile width is explicitly 52px with a 64px layout slot.

selfHostedFonts.fidelity: Three reference-inspired layers, not an exact identification or reproduction of the custom reference typefaces.

narrative.overview:
象牙网格底承托深青工作面，银、金、铜金属框与铆钉延续既有组件语言。左侧工业滑轨收为图标，悬停展开；用户提供的 G15 原图标识位于左上，流光响应悬停和键盘焦点。厚重标题、仪表黑体组件标题和方棱小字构成三个自托管字形层级。

这是一套用于 G15 教学沙盘的界面。实际查询与生成报告决定内容，视觉层保持未知、失败和未判定可辨。该设计记录不构成生产环境、真实工业诊断或 Gate0 的验收结论。实现为原生 HTML、CSS 和 ES modules；交付用户提供的品牌 PNG 与本地 OFL 字体，参考字形图仅作为风格依据，不声称精确复刻原字体。
keyCharacteristics: 象牙网格底、深青工作面、银金铜金属框和铆钉。
窄工业滑轨、悬停展开标签、点击 Logo 固定与恢复折叠。
健康、告警、异常与过期状态始终配文字。
三层自托管字体；读数和时间以等宽数字对齐。
图表检查落在实际存储窗口，数据范围与来源保持可见。

rules.name: The Labeled State Rule
rules.body: 状态色必须与明确的状态文字共同出现；连接提示、活动告警、历史告警和报告结论各自保留名称。

rules.name: The Data Type Rule
rules.body: 保留数值、单位、标识与解释的字形层级。未知不替换为零；检查某个历史窗口不改写标题处的最新窗口健康分。

rules.name: The Metal Frame Rule
rules.body: 新增同类组件继承金属框与内部细分隔；材质不承担业务状态，也不改变数据范围。

dos: Do 延用象牙网格、金属工作面与窄滑轨，使当前设备和当前页面易于识别。
Do 让状态色与文字共同表达含义，并分开标明活动状态、历史告警和报告结论。
Do 保留实际数据范围、单位、来源与未知值，使图表和报告可核查。
Do 在窄屏保留已选设备可见性，并用有字段标签的告警记录保障完整阅读。
Do 使用原生按钮、输入、select、details 和可见键盘焦点。
donts: Don't 把仿真结果、场景通过或接口可读取写成真实设备联网、生产就绪或 Gate0 通过。
Don't 把未知、未判定、null 或失败画成通过、零或满分。
Don't 从健康分另造告警阈值，或用历史告警代替当前活动状态。
Don't 为图表添加模拟实时跳动、补造缺失窗口或省略部分范围提示。
Don't 替换用户提供的品牌原图，或将相近的自托管字体声称为参考图精确同款。
Don't 把仿真采集启停写成物理设备控制，或用装饰动画暗示没有发生的数据传输。
